LanguageData.PFE_Rec1: An alert when items have nowhere to go
LanguageData.PFE_Rec2: Whole categories are allowed, so new items of the same kind fit too
LanguageData.PFE_Rec3: Storages with default names get a label of what is inside
LanguageData.PFE_Alert_Desc: Shows how many kinds of items no stockpile or shelf accepts. Click it to open the preview.
LanguageData.PFE_WholeCategory_Desc: Adds the item's whole category (e.g. all raw stone blocks), not only the one item – new items of the same kind then have a place too.
LanguageData.PFE_Rename_Desc: Stockpiles and shelf groups with a default name get a label of what they hold ("Freezer – Raw food, Meals"). Names you wrote yourself are never changed.
LanguageData.PFE_Forbidden_Desc: Also look for a place for items you have forbidden.
LanguageData.PFE_Intro: Items that no stockpile or shelf accepts. Each gets the best place in your storage – change it with the button, untick what you want to leave. Only allowances are added; nothing your storage takes now is removed.
LanguageData.PFE_Applied: {0} kinds of items got a place in {1} storages.
LanguageData.PFE_Undone: The last change of storage was undone.
LanguageData.PFE_AlertDesc: Some kinds of items lying around are not accepted by any stockpile or shelf, so nobody hauls them.\n\nClick to see where each could go and confirm.
LanguageData.PFE_ButtonDesc: Find items that no storage accepts and give them a logical place (preview first).
LanguageData.PFE_OnlyHome_Desc: Only items lying inside the home area count – not loot far away on the map.
LanguageData.PFE_Chunks_Desc: Rock and slag chunks usually stay where they lie. Turn on to find a place for them too.
